statement: Experiential moral beauty may be associated with bearing the Image of God.
objections: Alternative accounts of experience and aesthetic capacity
reversal_condition: A justified account that severs or revises the proposed link.

statement: Objective moral good may be grounded in divine holiness and relational alignment.
objections: Normative authority must not be defined vacuously
reversal_condition: A stronger rival account or failure of a necessary bridge.

statement: A real relational distinction does not follow to be impossible merely from an exclusion of metaphysical composition; a bridge connecting relational distinction to composition is needed.
objections: Whether the encoding matches classical simplicity remains unresolved
reversal_condition: A justified definition or independent premise establishing the relevant bridge.

statement: Moral-discovery training may improve out-of-distribution moral generalisation.
reversal_condition: Matched tests show no gain or a competing explanation accounts for the gain.
